notes.title: What's Next & Small bugfix.
notes.notes:
What's  Next in Corner Kitchen? 🚨

🏗️ Coming Soon: Kitchen Expansion & Delivery System!
🍳 Kitchen Expansion
Running out of room back there? Get ready to expand your kitchen! You’ll soon be able to buy new space, reorganize your stations, and scale your fast food empire like never before.

🛵 Online Orders & Delivery
It’s time to go digital. Customers will soon be able to place online orders, and delivery drivers will stop by your restaurant to pick up the food and deliver it. A whole new layer of management and strategy is on the way!


             ✅ Live Now: Small Fixes, Big Quality

🗂️ Smarter Shelf Management
You can now mark food shelves just like stations! Assign what products your runners should place where, giving you even more control over how your kitchen is stocked.

🍟 Fries Stats Fixed
We’ve corrected the end-of-day fries display, so your stats now reflect reality — no more mysterious fry count errors.

🧃 Runners Refill Fix
Runners will now properly refill stations as long as ingredients are available in storage. No more standing around while orders pile up!

⌨️ Key Binding Tweaks
Added a key binding for "Drop"

Removed the duplicate key binding for "Jump"

Stay sharp and stay greasy,
👨‍🍳 The Corner Kitchen Dev Team

notes.title: Corner Kitchen Small Update
notes.notes:
🍔 Corner Kitchen Small Update: Better Stats, Fewer Bugs, and More Control! 🍟
Hey everyone! We’ve been cooking up some improvements for Corner Kitchen: Fast Food Simulator, and we’re excited to share this latest update with you! Here’s what’s new:

🔥 Improvements & New Features
✅ End-of-Day Statistics Overhaul – Get a more detailed breakdown of your performance, earnings, and worker efficiency.
✅ Worker Attendance Info & Call-In Feature – If your worker didn’t show up due to lack of funds, you’ll now see why. Plus, if you’ve got the money now, you can call them in!
✅ Sell Your Old Furniture & Paints – Mason’s Shop now buys back furniture and paints for half their original price. Time to clear out that storage!
✅ 4K Resolution Support – Enjoy crispy visuals with full support for 4K displays.

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Adjustments
🔹 Kitchen Glitch Fixed – Customers will no longer walk through your kitchen when exiting from the second floor.
🔹 Fries Station Fixed – No more sneaky extra fries packs from multiple clicks!
🔹 Hot Dog Vanishing Act Solved – Dismantling food shelves or the hot dog station? Hot dogs now fall into a container instead of disappearing.
🔹 Furniture Placement Issue Fixed – You can now properly place furniture against the left wall after unlocking the second section.

🎵 QoL & Audio Updates
🎧 Radio Upgrade – Channels now switch automatically after a song ends, and you can skip tracks with a click instead of holding the button.
🎤 Narrator Toggle – Don't want the narrator’s voice? Now you can disable it in the settings!
⚙️ "Run in Background" Option Added – Let the game keep running when minimized, if you prefer.

This update brings better control, better visuals, and a smoother experience overall. Keep the feedback coming, and as always, thanks for supporting Corner Kitchen! 🏪🔥

See you in the kitchen,
👨‍🍳 The Corner Kitchen Dev Team

notes.title: 🔧 New Features & Improvements
notes.notes:
🚀 Update Released for Corner Kitchen: Fast Food Simulator! 🍔

Hey, chefs! We’ve been cooking up some improvements, and a new update is now live! Here’s what’s fresh off the grill:

🔧 New Features & Improvements
✅ Storage Marking System – Now you can mark shelves for specific products, and runners will only place the designated items there.
✅ Open/Close Cash Registers – You now have full control over your registers. Close them when needed and optimize customer flow!
✅ Smarter Runners – They now prioritize using boxes with fewer items first, keeping your stock rotation efficient.
✅ Shelf Amount Display – No more guessing! Now you can see exactly how much is left in each box on the shelf.
✅ Improved Cashier Priority – Cashiers now collect items from food shelves first before retrieving from the cooking station.
✅ Runner Box Return – Runners now return boxes to the same shelves they were taken from, keeping your storage organized.
✅ Better Customer Distribution – When multiple cash registers are available, customers will now spread out more effectively.

🐛 Bug Fixes
🛠 Fixed an issue where customers could get stuck near tables.
🛠 Fixed the escape key bug.

🔜 What’s Next?
We’re excited to announce that we’ll soon be sharing a roadmap with upcoming content, including:
🍽 Kitchen Space Expansion – More room for cooking, more efficiency!
🔧 And much more—stay tuned!

Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep those burgers flipping and let us know what you think of the new update.

👨‍🍳 Happy cooking! 🔥

notes.title: We Are Live! The Game Is Now Released!
notes.notes:
🆕 What’s New?
👨‍🍳 New Worker Types:

Runner – Carries food boxes, restocks supplies, and refills cooking stations.
Chef Upgrade – Now refills stations when food boxes are available.
Cleaner – Keeps the restaurant spotless, no more garbage piles!
Cashier – Takes orders, collects food, and serves customers.
🏗️ Restaurant Expansion:

Grow your restaurant, expand the cooking area, and even open a second floor for more customers!
Add extra cash registers to handle the rush and keep customers happy.
🎨 Decorate & Personalize:

Paint walls and floors to match your style.
Add flowers, paintings, and custom signboards to make your restaurant stand out.
Rename your restaurant and truly make it your own!
💡 Make your restaurant your way – automate it, customize it, and run it like a pro!
